title: A deleted original work order stays as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, which is deleted after it was picked as line 2's original.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, whose line 2 was No Charge under Comeback with work order 2 as its original.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Notes tab.
  3. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  4. Set the date range to this month.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The note still shows work order 2's number.

Step 3:

  • The report opens.

Step 4:

  • Line 2's row shows work order 2's number with no link.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E5: “If the original work order is deleted, the line keeps the number as text and the report shows it without a link.”
